title: 第9章 楚小白第10章 血海深仇
slug: 培养神兽很难我有十只
content_zh:
楚望山原本以为巨狼站起来后，下一秒就要向他扑过来，但是巨狼却没有这么做。
观察了楚望山一会儿，巨狼扭头看向身侧，楚望山循着它的目光看过去，巨狼的身下竟然有一个小小的襁褓，一个小婴儿正在安稳的熟睡。
楚望山大惊，还没等他想出个所以然来，巨狼开口道：“收养这个孩子，然后把襁褓烧掉，我会一直看着你，不要动歪心思。”
传说只有八阶以上的灵兽才能口吐人言，这只巨狼至少是八阶的灵兽！
要知道，整个青乌镇三阶的灵兽都极为少见，这只巨狼竟然有八阶！
楚望山的祖宗十八代，都没有见过这么高品阶的灵兽！
巨狼见楚望山没有反应，继续道：“如果你不愿意收养少主，那我只能杀了你。”
听巨狼这么说，楚望山咽了口唾沫，壮着胆子走了过去，将孩子抱了起来。
襁褓已经被鲜血染红了大半，但婴儿却丝毫没有受伤，粉雕玉琢的小脸红扑扑的，一看就是富贵人家的孩子。
巨狼低头看着小婴儿，用鼻尖轻轻蹭了蹭襁褓，“好好照顾他，他叫少野，以后就跟你姓吧，不要告诉别人我的存在。”
楚望山抱着孩子浑浑噩噩地走出树林，在重新见到太阳的那一刻，要不是怀里还抱着个孩子，他还以为自己刚才是在做梦。
楚望山没摘到野果，反而带了个小婴儿回来，兰芳十分惊讶，“哪来的孩子啊？”
楚望山想了想，巨狼不让他告诉别人，但是自己的媳妇算不得别人，要收养孩子的话，这件事也瞒不过兰芳，就将刚才发生的事说了一遍。
“这可真是……”
兰芳不知道该说什么，收养这个孩子可能会给他们带来灭顶之祸，但是不养又不忍心。
即将成为人母的兰芳母爱泛滥，看着被裹在血襁褓中的小婴儿还是决定收养。
她拿出提前为未出世的孩子准备的小被子，将小婴儿从血襁褓中换了出来。
婴儿因为她的动作醒了过来，睁开眼睛看到兰芳就笑，还握住了她的一根手指。
兰芳的心顿时酥软的像化开的蜜糖，她亲了亲婴儿的额头，柔声道：“小家伙，以后我就是你娘了。”
楚望山的回忆到此结束，这么些年，他看着楚少野从牙牙学语的婴儿到现在的俊俏少年，早就把他当做了自己的亲生儿子。

他拍拍楚少野的肩：“儿啊，我知道你胸怀大志，不甘于在这个小村庄蹉跎一辈子，但是凡事都要量力而行，要是在赤霄宗过的不好，你就回来，爹和你娘永远都等着你。”
楚少野再稳重，此时也不过是个十二岁的少年，他眼眶微红，伸出双臂和楚望山抱了抱，“我知道的，爹。”
楚望山拍了拍他的背，顺手用手背抹了一下眼睛，“好了，快去睡觉吧，明天不是还要去打猎？”
楚少野点了点头，跟楚望山道了晚安，回了自己的屋。
楚望山平复了一下心情回到了卧室，兰芳还没睡着，在等着他，“跟儿子聊完啦？”
楚望山嗯了一声，还带着一些鼻音。
兰芳戳了一下他的脑门，“瞧你这没出息的样，哭什么？”
楚望山瓮声瓮气道：“再怎么说也只是个十二岁的孩子，清瑶还好，和青鱼能做个伴儿，他自己去赤霄宗我怎么放心的下。”
content_en:
Chu Wangshan originally thought that the giant wolf would pounce on him the next second after it stood up, but the giant wolf did not do so.
After observing Chu Wangshan for a while, the giant wolf turned to look to his side. Chu Wangshan followed its gaze and saw that there was a small swaddle under the giant wolf, and a baby was sleeping peacefully.
Chu Wangshan was shocked. Before he could figure out the reason, the giant wolf said: "Adopt this child and then burn the baby. I will always watch you and don't have any evil thoughts."
Legend has it that only spiritual beasts of the eighth level and above can speak human words. This giant wolf is at least an eighth-level spiritual beast!
You know, third-level spiritual beasts are extremely rare in Qingwu Town, but this giant wolf actually has an eighth-level one!
None of the eighteen generations of Chu Wangshan’s ancestors had ever seen such a high-level spiritual beast!
Seeing that Chu Wangshan didn't respond, Julang continued: "If you are unwilling to adopt the young master, then I can only kill you."
Hearing what the giant wolf said, Chu Wangshan swallowed, bravely walked over and picked up the child.
Most of the swaddling clothes were stained red with blood, but the baby was not injured at all. The little face was so red that it looked like a child from a wealthy family.
The giant wolf looked down at the little baby and gently rubbed the swaddling clothes with the tip of his nose. "Take good care of him. His name is Shaoye. I will take your last name from now on. Don't tell others about my existence."
Chu Wangshan walked out of the woods in a daze with his child in his arms. The moment he saw the sun again, if he hadn't been holding a child in his arms, he would have thought he was dreaming just now.
Chu Wangshan did not pick wild fruits, but brought back a baby. Lan Fang was very surprised, "Where did the child come from?"
Chu Wangshan thought about it and realized that Julang wouldn't let him tell others, but his wife was not someone else. If he wanted to adopt a child, he couldn't hide it from Lan Fang, so he told her what happened just now.
"This is really..."
Lan Fang didn't know what to say. Adopting this child might bring disaster to them, but he couldn't bear it if he didn't adopt him.
Lan Fang, who was about to become a mother, was overflowing with maternal love and decided to adopt the baby after seeing the baby wrapped in blood.
She took out the small quilt she had prepared for her unborn child in advance and changed the baby out of the bloody swaddling clothes.
The baby woke up because of her actions, opened his eyes, smiled when he saw Lan Fang, and held one of her fingers.
Lan Fang's heart suddenly felt as soft as melted honey. She kissed the baby's forehead and said softly: "Little one, I will be your mother from now on."
Chu Wangshan's memories ended here. Over the years, he had watched Chu Shaoye grow from a babbling baby to a handsome young man now, and he had long regarded him as his biological son.
He patted Chu Shaoye on the shoulder: "Son, I know you have great ambitions and are not willing to waste your whole life in this small village, but you have to do everything within your ability. If you don't have a good life in the Scarlet Xiao Sect, you can come back. Dad and your mother will always be waiting for you."
No matter how steady Chu Shaoye is, he is still just a twelve-year-old boy at this time. His eyes were slightly red, and he stretched out his arms to hug Chu Wangshan, "I know, dad."
Chu Wangshan patted his back and wiped his eyes with the back of his hand, "Okay, go to bed quickly, don't you have to go hunting tomorrow?"
Chu Shaoye nodded, said good night to Chu Wangshan, and returned to his house.
Chu Wangshan calmed down and returned to the bedroom. Lan Fang was still waiting for him, "Have you finished talking to your son?"
Chu Wangshan hummed, with some nasal sounds.
Lan Fang poked his forehead and said, "Look at you, you look so worthless, why are you crying?"
Chu Wangshan said angrily: "After all, he is only a twelve-year-old child. Qingyao is okay. He can be a companion with Qingyu. How can I feel relieved that he will go to Scarlet Xiao Sect by himself?"
